integration.buildScript: Passed: frontend/backend Wasm, frontend/backend standalone Windows EXE, website, Android APK
integration.desktop: Windows standalone EXE: UI, repeated HTTP JSON, cookie sessions; DNS/TCP/UDP/WebSocket round trips

limitations: Ordinary web pages do not expose raw TCP/UDP sockets; capability queries report unsupported.
iOS has the portable adapter contracts but no packaged iOS host in this repository.
Server sessions are held in process memory.
